data.name: Moses
data.gender_notes: Moses is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In the Bible, Moses was an Israelite who led the Hebrews out of Egypt and received the Ten Commandments from God. The name Moses comes from the Hebrew word 'mosheh', meaning 'drawn out' or 'saved from the water'. The name Moses carries the meaning “Drawn from the water” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Moses usually hope their child will grow to embody drawn from the water and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes deliverance and leadership in the face of adversity.
data.etymology: Moses belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Drawn from the water.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Moses total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_hebrew.name: משה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם משה הוא עברי ומשמעותו 'מושע ה' הוציא ממצרים', כפי שנאמר בספר שמות, פרק ב', פסוק י': 'וַתִּקְרָא שְׁמוֹ מֹשֶׁה וְאָמְרָה כִּי מִן הַמַּיִם מְשִׁיתִוֹ'.

in_greek.name: Μωυσής
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο Μωυσής είναι η ελληνική μορφή του εβραϊκού ονόματος משה, που σημαίνει 'ο ριζοσπαστος' ή 'αυτός που τραβάει από το νερό', αναφερόμενος στο γεγονός ότι το μωρό Μωυσής ανασύρθηκε από το Νείλο από την κόρη του Φαραώ.

in_latin.name: Moses
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Moses Hebraeum est, cuius significatio est 'extractus de aquis' vel 'liberatus', referens ad historiam Moysis in libro Exodi descriptam, qui a famula Pharaonis de flumine Nilo extractus est.

in_english.name: Moses
in_english.meaning: he who is drawn out of the water
in_english.long_meaning: The name Moses originates from the Hebrew name משה (Moshe), which means 'he who is drawn out of the water'. It is derived from the verb משה (mshh), meaning 'to draw out'. In the biblical context, Moses was drawn out of the Nile River by Pharaoh's daughter. Moses is a significant figure in the Christian tradition, known for leading the Israelites out of slavery in Egypt and receiving the Ten Commandments from God.

data.cultural_impact: Moses is an iconic figure in Jewish and Christian history. He is known as the Lawgiver, as he transmitted the Ten Commandments to the Israelites. His story of leading the Israelites out of slavery in Egypt has been a source of inspiration for countless works of art, literature, and music. The image of Moses with the Ten Commandments tablets is a common symbol of the Jewish and Christian traditions, representing freedom, deliverance, and the foundational principles of morality.
data.spiritual_significance: Moses is revered in both Jewish and Christian traditions as a prophet and a leader who sounded the call to faith and obedience to God. He set an example of living a dedicated life to God, even in the face of adversity. As a spiritual figure, Moses represents the idea of leading one's people towards the Promised Land, the ultimate goal of a journey towards a deeper relationship with God. His faith, courage, and commitment to God's will continue to inspire individuals on their own spiritual journeys.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Moses: Deliverer from bondage, leading God's people towards the Promised Land, symbolizing guidance and liberation from earthly struggles towards a divine destiny.

biblical_reference.note: Moses is a central figure in the Hebrew Bible and the Christian Old Testament.

historical_references.reference: Born in Egypt around 1391 BC, Moses was adopted by the Pharaoh's daughter and raised as an Egyptian prince.
Historical records show that Moses led the Israelites out of Egypt and received the Ten Commandments from God on Mount Sinai. The name Moses carried significant spiritual weight in that era.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Moses remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted Christian named David Moses in Rome, Italy credits much of their spiritual journey to their name Moses, which means "Drawn from the water". They believe their name has been a blessing and reminder of God's presence in their life.
